Selected fresh analytic question: Luo arXiv:2609.11418v2 Problem10.1, full classification of Gaussian signal fractions0<q<=4/7 yielding weighted entropy concavity for every symmetric log-concave variance-one density. Latest actual source and closest proof bodies read; three other claims screened and excluded/deferred.

1. Ball–Nayar–Tkocz, arXiv:1509.05926, Conjecture 1, PDF p3: for every symmetric log-concave random vector, exponentiated differential entropy of one-dimensional projections is a norm. Equivalent planar assertion: exp h(X+Y) <= exp h(X)+exp h(Y), allowing dependence. Not selected: substantially broader geometric assertion; neither the classical Ball section-norm bound nor the source's Proposition 1 removes the factor e. This is distinct from the independent two-copy question.

2. Same paper, Conjecture 2, PDF p6: for every iid log-concave real pair, h(sqrt(t)X+sqrt(1-t)Y) is concave on [0,1]. EXCLUDE PUBLIC REFUTATION. Luo arXiv:2609.11418v2 (14 September 2026), Theorems 1.1 and 1.2, supplies asymmetric and symmetric counterexamples respectively. The actual latest PDF is v2, despite search snippets describing only v1's asymmetric result. Its symmetric theorem already covers every signal fraction q>4/7. No rediscovery of that interval.

2. Harper–Kohli–Song–Tahar arXiv:2509.16868v1, Conjecture 1.8: for every alternating link L, all integer i,j,k,l satisfy |a_(i+k,j+l)| |a_(i-k,j-l)| <= |a_(i,j)|^2 for LG(L), and its support has no interior lattice holes. Latest abs reports v1, while the fetched v1 body itself is dated August 24, 2026; preserve that discrepancy. Source Definitions 1.2/1.7, Sections 5.2–5.4 and Proposition 5.4 read. Torus links and twist knots are already covered, with the latter proof explicitly omitting remaining coefficient cases. No all-link proof located in this bounded screen; not selected because the required invariant computation and arbitrary alternating-link bridge are substantially less controlled. No claim that its public finite cases prove the universal statement.
